name: Rule A Kingdom {Elections! 🗳️}
desc:
🏰 Start as a peasant and work your way up into the kingdom
🧺 Work in shops around the kingdom
👮‍♂️ Become a Guard and enforce the laws
🥼 Heal your fellow citizens as a doctor
👑Fight your way to the top and become the king

VERSION 1.1
	⭐ Election System: Vote the king out of power! 

	⭐ Class Skill Levels: Level up each class by doing your role's job!

	⭐ Bandit no longer pays taxes and Bandit shop can no longer be closed.

	⭐ Guard price changed from 400 to 600 coins.

	⭐ Buying swords with robux now gives the advanced sword.

	⭐ Wheat required to make a meal changed from 10 to 5.

	⭐ Buying a spot in line for King changed from 500 to 1000 coins.

	⭐ Various other bug fixes and minor changes


    [This game is still in development]
